rules.rule: No secrets in code, tests, fixtures, or commit contents: API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings, private keys. Reference them by environment variable name only.

Any migration that creates a table reachable by more than one principal must enable row level security and add owner-scoped policies in the same migration. If ownership is unclear, RLS on with no policies.
Do not hand-roll authentication, session management, password handling, or cryptography. Use the platform auth service or a vetted library.
Database schema changes must be named migration files. Flag ad-hoc DDL in application code, scripts, or runbooks aimed at production.
Tests must not be weakened to pass: no removed or skipped tests, loosened tolerances or assertions, or hardcoded expected values replacing a recomputation.
Pull requests from agents must not modify CI workflows, CLAUDE.md, AGENT_RULES.md, SECURITY.md, or review-tool configuration (.greptile, greptile.json, .macroscope).

Methodology rule 5: automated assessments stay draft. Agent PRs must not set any assessment to published, add or change provenance.reviewers or review approvals, or edit rating verdicts; only Li publishes.
